page_title: Nsketch AI - AI Image & Video Generator Studio

sources.entry: Nsketch AI - AI image and video generation platform with 20+ models and ready-made templates for creators.

summary.name: Nsketch AI
summary.one_liner: Nsketch AI is a web-based AI studio for generating images and videos from text, with an upscaler, editing tools, and ready-made visual templates and effects.
use_cases: create short AI dance or trend videos
upscale or enhance image resolution to 4K
apply retro or cinematic photo filters
produce visuals for social media content
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Nsketch AI as an AI image and video generation studio that turns text into visuals. It lists an upscaler and editing tools alongside generation. The page shows a large catalog of ready-made templates, including viral dance video trends and photo effects such as VHS, Y2K digital camera, 8MM film, and golden hour looks. It also mentions a 4K Enhancer and a Seedance 2.5 model being available on the platform. A directory listing describes it as offering 20+ models for creators.
notable: Catalog of ready-made templates for dance trends, editorial portraits, and photo filters
Reported to offer 20+ AI models (per directory listing)
Seedance 2.5 model announced on the platform
caveats: Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
Page text is mostly a list of template names with little technical detail
